items.title: Fact check: Did misleading claims about Spain's migration law trigger the Ceuta crisis?
items.description: More than 70 people died after thousands of migrants tried to cross from Morocco into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta. The crossings have been linked to misleading claims about a recent Spanish Supreme Court ruling.

items.title: What does Zambia's opposition stand without Edgar Lungu?
items.description: The death of former President Edgar Lungu reshaped opposition politics in Zambia ahead of the August 13 general election. Analysts say the vote will test whether his legacy can keep opposition supporters united.
